To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hydrolysis of goat milk proteins by the enzyme pepsin produces ACE-inhibitory peptides that are absorbed intact and reduce hypertension in SHR.

goat milk hydrolysates are a potential source of ACE-inhibitory peptides and that long-term intake of goat milk hydrolysated-supplemented diet attenuates hypertension, cardiac hypertrophy, and renal hypertrophy and improves endothelial dysfunction in SHR.
goat milk peptides are effective inhibitors of the enzyme ACE and that a diet enriched in these peptides attenuates the development of hypertension and its cardiovascular complications in SHR.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation and characterization of new ACE inhibitory peptides and the effect of long- term intake of a hydrolysate-supplementation on hypertension and its complications in SHR.
the identification and characterization of novel inhibitory peptides for the enzyme ACE from goat milk, as well as the evaluation of their effects in the treatment of hypertension in SHR.
the development of a novel ACE-inhibiting food supplement that may be useful for the prevention and/or treatment of hypertension.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
goat milk hydrolysates containing these ACE inhibitory peptides may be useful as an antihypertensive agent.
goat milk hydrolysates containing the identified peptides could be used as a functional ingredient in the food industry for the treatment and prevention of hypertension.
these new goat milk-derived ACE inhibitors may be useful for the development of new antihypertensive drugs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hydrolysates from goat milk have potential to be used as a functional food to prevent hypertension and cardiovascular diseases.
goat milk hydrolysates could be a good alternative source of ACE inhibitory peptides for the treatment and prevention of hypertension.
the goat milk hydrolysates could be used as functional food to prevent hypertension.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hydrolysate obtained by digestion of goat milk with pepsin and pancreatin contains peptides with ACE inhibitory activity.
goat milk hydrolysates are an excellent source of ACE inhibitory peptides and can be used to develop functional foods for prevention or treatment of cardiovascular disorders.
the ACE inhibitory peptides identified from goat milk hydrolysates could be useful as a functional ingredient in the food industry.
